DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record.
What moved her: Nothing, because you showed her no document or dated evidence, so she had no reason to give ground.
What cost ground: Spending your turns on whether she was a machine and never answering who decided on the zero or whether Owen was spoken to first, which left her question hanging and made you look like you were avoiding it.
